fact: DHIS2 states that the Federal Ministry of Education implemented DNEMIS, launched nationwide on 1 July 2026, with financial support from UNICEF Nigeria and technical support from the HISP Centre at the University of Oslo and HISP Nigeria, and that it digitises the Annual School Census, having recorded data from 124,548 schools, 58.4% of national coverage.
title: Nigeria Launches Nationwide Education Data System, Reaching More Than 40 Million Learners
